name: How should homeowners prepare their bathroom before tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their bathroom before tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your tile installation begins, clear out all personal belongings, measure your space, and confirm the specific layout pattern you want. Empty all cabinets, counters, and shower ledges, and establish clear pathway access for the crew. You should decide on your preferred grout color, tile direction (such as stacked, offset, or herringbone), and exact placement for shower niches or accent bands ahead of time. Knowing the thickness of your chosen tile also helps verify proper transitions to adjacent hallway flooring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all personal items, decide on tile layout and grout color, and confirm niche locations and flooring transitions before work begins.
